name: CodeGeeX
official_status_notes: Open multilingual code model (CodeGeeX4-ALL-9B, GLM lineage) plus official VS Code/JetBrains extensions; a local-mode deployment guide connects the extensions to a self-hosted model. Code under Apache-2.0; model weights under a separate Model License (commercial use requires registration) (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free extension; self-hosted model on your own hardware; check commercial terms for the weights.
best_for: Open-weight autocomplete/code assistant you can self-host for privacy or research.
strengths: Strong small-model benchmark results; local mode; VS Code + JetBrains.
weaknesses: Weights license restricts commercial use; less polish than commercial assistants.
hardware_requirements: 9B model self-hosting wants ~16 GB RAM; cloud extension mode is light.
